* **Board Approval of Financial Results:** On October 19, 2026, the Board of Directors approved the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone) along with the Limited Review Report for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026.
* **Key Financial Figures (Quarter Ended Sept 30, 2026):** The company reported total income of ₹1,16,404.39 Lakhs, profit before tax of ₹8,317.37 Lakhs, and net profit for the period of ₹6,051.07 Lakhs (with half-year net profit reaching ₹18,417.79 Lakhs).
